findings:
RESULTS (final clean run): lint, typecheck, format:check, build exit 0 (/en,/ne SSG; all /admin/* dynamic). npm test 38 files/388 tests (unit 29/313, db 9/75). Playwright 78 passed: public 38 (baseline unchanged), setup 2, admin-readonly 23, admin-mutations 15. axe serious/critical = 0 on /admin/login 1280+375, /admin owner 1280+375, admin mobile menu 375, /admin/posts/new 1280. AC31 hygiene clean; git log: no commits; AC32 fence exit 1; DB stopped at the end.

UNVERIFIED OUTCOMES: revalidatePath alone made AC9/AC10 fresh on the next request; the 6.4 unstable_cache + updateTag fallback was NOT applied. AC14 real 3xx without loading.tsx confirmed (maxRedirects 0). [...rest] does not shadow (dashboard) routes; /admin/does-not-exist -> 404 admin heading. next-auth beta.32 login/session/logout work under next start.

DEVIATIONS / DECISIONS: (1) (dashboard)/layout.tsx renders `children` (no shell) instead of `null` when there is no actor, so the page still renders and its own guard issues the 307 (with null the page element would never render). The layout never redirects; admin-structure test asserts that. (2) next.config.ts has an explicit `/admin` header source in addition to `/admin/:path*` (belt and braces), so the run does not prove `:path*` alone covers `/admin`. (3) Form field components (fields.tsx, BilingualField, SlugField, DateTimeField, MarkdownEditor) are client components reading field errors from FormShell context; field ids are `f-<name>` (dots -> '-'). Bilingual labels read '<Label> (English)' / '<Label> (नेपाली, Nepali)' for unique accessible names. (4) Delete buttons live outside the editor form (ConfirmDialog owns a hidden form; nested forms are invalid). (5) Added an admin-only `.admin-root [lang="ne"]` font rule to globals.css (no public change). (6) README rewritten; .env.example already matched §15 and was left unchanged. (7) FlashToast reads window.location instead of useSearchParams (no Suspense needed). (8) Toast region has data-testid='toasts' for E2E.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS: At 1280x900 the sidebar's last item 'Log out' sits at the fold (the sidebar scrolls independently). Full-page screenshots show the sticky save bars mid-image (Playwright capture of position:sticky), not a layout bug. Uploads are not implemented (Phase 7); every link field says so. An untracked, non-ignored `.vitest/json/output.json` existed before this feature; left in place. The first E2E run had one strict-mode locator failure in admin-content (test-side, fixed); no app change was needed. During bookkeeping a stdin-blocked node command emptied this JSON file; it was rewritten from the original content plus status/findings.
